title: Exam & Office Administrator
description:
Exam & Office Administrator

Location: Brighton And Hove, UK

Salary: SCP 04 - 06 £20,420 - £20,791.20 (Actual Pro Rata Salary)

Contract Type: Permanent

Working Patterns: Part-Time

Application Deadline: Friday, 30th October 2026

Interview Date: W/C 9th November 2026

Expected Working Start Date: 11/2026

Visa Sponsorship Available: No

Is a Shared Job: No

About us

At Aldridge Adult Learning, part of Aldridge Education, we are passionate about changing lives through learning. We provide high-quality education and training that helps adults build confidence, gain valuable skills and achieve their career aspirations. By putting teaching, learning and learner support at the heart of everything we do, we create an inclusive environment where every learner can thrive.

Join us as our Exams and Office Administrator

The aim of the role is to provide high-quality administrative support for learner services, examinations, and office functions across Aldridge Adult Learning (AAL).

The post holder will maintain learner records, coordinate examinations and assessments, support learners and curriculum teams, and ensure compliance with organisational and awarding body requirements.

Working closely with staff, learners, and external partners, the successful candidate will contribute to learner achievement, provide excellent customer service, and support the smooth day-to-day running of the organisation.

Reporting to the Office Manager, the Exams and Office Administrator will work collaboratively across AAL to maintain effective systems and contribute to the organisation's ongoing success and reputation.

We welcome applications from all sections of the community and particularly encourage applications from underrepresented demographics.

About Aldridge Education:

AAL is a member of the Aldridge Education family of schools, which locally also includes BACA, PACA and Dukes.

Aldridge Education is a charitable Trust of entrepreneurial community schools and colleges that help young people to reach their potential. We support our schools Principals and teachers in rapidly improving the quality of education on offer at early years, primary, secondary and sixth-form levels in order to transform the life-chances of our students

Operating Norms:

We believe that the way we operate at all times and with all partners is of paramount importance.
Our agreed operating norms are as follows:
- We are Aldridge Education
- The standard is excellence
- We champion equality
- We re in the work together
- We behave with integrity
- We lead by example
- We use time well

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Aldridge Education, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

title: Fleet Customer Service Advisors

title: Receptionist
description:
